generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Tenderers registered in BBMP or equivalent registration of KPWD/CPWD or any state governmental organization for the execution works

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years (i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26).Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover (one similar work) of Rs 42.34 Lakhs
Satisfactorily completed (at least 50% of the contract value), as prime contractor, at least one similar work/Civil work of value not less than Rs.21.17 Lakhs
Contractor should submit line of credit/letter of credit to meet credit facility for the above work 30% of amount put to tender Rs 12.70 Lakhs
